description: This source file defines a Java interface 'DocumentsApiFixed' for interacting with a REST API related to document management within the Fineract project. It includes methods for creating, deleting, downloading, retrieving, listing, and updating documents, with annotations indicating HTTP request types and endpoints.

classes.name: DocumentsApiFixed
classes.description: A Java interface for document-related API endpoints, originally generated by OpenAPI Generator and manually edited to fix issues related to binary document upload notation.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document using multipart form upload, with required fields 'file' and 'description', and optional 'name'.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a specified document by its ID.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads the binary file associated with a specific document.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific document.

methods.name: retrieveAllDocuments
methods.description: Lists all documents associated with a given entity.

methods.name: updateDocument
methods.description: Updates an existing document using multipart form upload, similar to creation.
